title: "wrapped fixture: metadata function values of zero"
filters:
  - wrapped
format: html
wrapped:
  breakpoint: calc(0px)
  width: calc(0%)
---

![A wrapped figure.](plot.png){#fig-meta-calc-zero .wrap-right}

A width of zero is not a width, so the width stays at its default, with a warning. A breakpoint of zero is a length, so it stays as written.
